description.value: Pizazz Pizza is a family-owned Victoria institution that has been serving the community since 1998, offering a broad menu of pizzas, pasta, wings, and salads. The restaurant actively accommodates dietary restrictions with gluten-free crust, whole wheat options, and vegan alternatives. Both takeout and delivery are available, making it a practical refueling stop for cyclists in the Wilkinson Road area of Saanich.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is current and comprehensive (copyright 2026), confirming an active family-owned pizza restaurant operating since 1998 with takeout and delivery. The About Us page explicitly lists gluten-free, whole wheat, and vegan options, confirming dietary accommodations. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record is missing address and phone number; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields for those are null.

Contact page contains a lorem ipsum/placeholder passage ('Panpie is an ambitious multimedia effort...') suggesting the website template was not fully customized, though all functional content (menu, address, hours) appears legitimate.
Bike parking and washroom availability are unconfirmed — a follow-up visit or call would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established local restaurant (operating since 1998) with confirmed takeout service and dietary-friendly options; a practical food stop for touring cyclists in the Saanich/Wilkinson Road corridor of Greater Victoria.

Takeout.detail: Website prominently advertises 'Takeway' with an estimated 30-minute pick-up time, and multiple 'Pick-up Only' specials are listed on the front page and menu

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About Us page states: 'We try to accommodate people with dietary restrictions and allergies by providing alternative options (gluten-free, whole wheat, vegan).' Gluten-free pizza is also highlighted on the front page

wow_evidence: family-owned Victoria institution that has been serving the community since 1998
